svg.title: British Columbia Forest Service — vector reconstruction
svg.desc: Independent reconstruction from the supplied reference. Concentric ellipse geometry, individually positioned custom outlined letters, and separately authored landscape and evergreen paths. No bitmap tracing or embedded image. This is a reconstructed artwork, not an authenticated official vector master.

g.inkscape:label: Oval geometry — background, outer gold rule and inner rim
Blue sky and horizontal white cloud bands
Distant forest on the opposite shore
Lake, level far shoreline and individual ripples
Foreground shore, rocks and ground marks
Central evergreen — outline, canopy, needle cuts and trunk
